plainText:
The Beedrill All and End All (Japanese: VSスピアー VS ) is the 88th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 48th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
 wonders who is, having never met him before; conversely, Pika is enraged to see Giovanni who merely sneers at him. Yellow, reading Pika's memories, realizes that Pika has fought with Giovanni. As Lance tries to hide using bubbles again, Giovanni sends out his to blow sand all over the smaller bubbles, revealing them and allowing his to break them. However, Nidoqueen is unable to break the main bubble. Lance mocks Giovanni, but Giovanni merely rolls his 's Poké Ball underneath the main bubble and pierces it with , dropping Lance into the middle of the net and entangling him.

Giovanni, looming over the bound Lance, declares that he cannot permit the Elite Four to wage war on Kanto before he can assume control over it. Lance merely acknowledges Giovanni as the leader of Team Rocket, surprising Yellow who recognizes Giovanni as the one who attempted to exploit Viridian Forest two years in the past.

Suddenly, high above a massive amount of energy gathers in the sky, much to Lance's pleasure.

==Major events==
's spirit appears above Cerise Island.

==Trivia==
This chapter is included in The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow.
The English title comes from the phrase "be all and end all", meaning the most important part or reason for something.

===Errors===
In the VIZ Media second edition, the is referred to as the Earth Type.
